name: Monash Health Gender Clinic
title: Public specialist gender clinic
description: "The Monash Health Gender Clinic is the specialist public health service for the Trans, Gender Diverse and Non-Binary community in Victoria." Accepts referrals (GP or specialist) for people aged 16 and above living in Victoria. Performs WPATH-based mental health assessments, after which clients can be referred to Monash Health Endocrinology for gender affirming hormone therapy (Monash Gender Endocrinology does not take over hormone care started elsewhere). Long wait list: in October 2026 it was booking clients referred in June 2024.
specialties: Gender assessment, referral to gender endocrinology, surgery assessments, psychiatry, psychology, peer support

name: Dr Cate Rayner
title: Dr, Paediatrician; Director, RCH Gender Service
description: Paediatrician and Director, Department of Adolescent Medicine, and Director of the RCH Gender Service, which she joined in 2021. The RCH Gender Service is a Victorian statewide service providing gender affirming care to trans and gender diverse children and adolescents; new referrals (from a GP or paediatrician) are accepted for children and adolescents up to 16 years.
specialties: Paediatrics, adolescent medicine, trans and gender diverse young people

name: Associate Professor Michelle Telfer
title: A/Prof, Paediatrician and Chief of Medicine
description: "Michelle has been instrumental in the development and expansion of the RCH Gender Service since 2012. She is a strong advocate for legal change and improved access to medical and mental health care for transgender and gender diverse children and adolescents in Australia." RCH Gender Service accepts referrals (GP or paediatrician) for children and adolescents up to 16 years.
specialties: Paediatrics, trans and gender diverse children and adolescents

name: Dr Debi Feldman
title: Dr, Paediatrician
description: Paediatrician who joined the RCH Gender Service in 2013 and "enjoys the opportunity to work with this remarkable group of children and young people." RCH Gender Service provides gender affirming care to trans and gender diverse children and adolescents; referrals (GP or paediatrician) accepted up to 16 years.
specialties: Paediatrics, trans and gender diverse children and adolescents

name: Associate Professor Ken Pang
title: A/Prof, Paediatrician and Research Lead, Department of Adolescent Medicine
description: Paediatrician who joined the RCH Gender Service in December 2015, with a clinical focus on child and adolescent mental health; leads the service's research. "Ken is excited to assist and learn from children, adolescent and families dealing with gender issues". Referrals (GP or paediatrician) accepted up to 16 years.
specialties: Paediatrics, adolescent mental health, trans and gender diverse young people, research

name: Dr Thea Bloom
title: Dr, Paediatrician
description: Paediatrician who joined the RCH Gender Service in 2022 after working with the service as an Adolescent Medicine Fellow in 2019; "appreciates the opportunity to learn from the trans and gender diverse young people she works with." Referrals (GP or paediatrician) accepted up to 16 years.
specialties: Paediatrics, adolescent medicine, trans and gender diverse young people
